note: Numbered amendments of docs/ui-editor-gate-rules-views1.md section 9. A spec of specs-views1.json is read with its amendments applied: `skip` lists 0-based step indexes left out, `replace` maps a 0-based index to the steps that replace it, `insertAfter` maps a 0-based index to the steps added after it. specs-views1.json itself is never edited.

byteComparisonInformationOnly.note: Specs whose export legitimately differs from the baseline's because an edit they make in the Phone view is custom to Phone now (rules amendment A5). compare-exports.mjs reads them like the specs with retired steps: compared and printed, not counted.

specs.N08: a resize made in the Phone view: the baseline wrote it linked (`#art { width: 328px; max-width: 100%; }`), the new page writes it custom (`@media (max-width: 640px) { #art { width: 328px; } }`)
